File every sentence under that heading. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

S23 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: I have also advised him to avoid citrus foods, fruits, and spicy foods until his symptoms have improved.

S26 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: RESPIRATORY: Normal respiratory effort no respiratory distress
S27 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: I have also advised him to change his diet, decrease alcohol, and caffeine.

S29 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: No peritoneal signs.
S30 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: I recommended a upper endoscopy for further evaluation.
S31 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: NECK: No adenopathy, thyromegaly.
